response.sql:
WITH project_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    p.arcregistry AS project_id,
    p.fundflux AS funding_source,
    AVG(s.boxx / NULLIF(s.boxz, 0)) AS ratio
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS s
    ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
  WHERE s.boxx IS NOT NULL
    AND s.boxz IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    project_id,
    funding_source,
    ratio,
    ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS margin
  FROM project_ratios
)
SELECT project_id, funding_source, ratio, margin
FROM ranked
ORDER BY margin DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A project's ratio is the average of its matched spatial records' boxx-to-boxz ratios; records with either dimension missing are ignored, and boxz = 0 yields an undefined ratio. The funding-source average compares these per-project ratios, giving each project equal weight.
